facts.raw_span: persistent severe pain on the left side of her face
episodic sharp, electric-shock–like pain initially affecting the entire left hemiface
pain localized to the V2 and V3 distributions of the left trigeminal nerve
attacks lasted 4–5 seconds
triggered by jaw movement during eating or tooth brushing
reached 10/10 on a numeric pain scale
allodynia to cold air
hypersensitivity to touch in the affected area
distorted sensations in the V2 region
sensory testing was otherwise normal
no other neurological deficits
Contrast-enhanced MRI of the head showed no abnormalities
